audit_items.proof_trace: The property is enforced by two layered mechanisms: (1) an application-level guard at L234-243 that queries for an existing active member (supabase_auth_user_id = user.id AND deleted_at IS NULL) and returns early on match; (2) an inferred DB-level unique constraint on supabase_auth_user_id (it is used as the primary key everywhere — no separate id column is inserted, it is passed directly as member_id FK in relation tables, and .single() is used on it in 10+ query sites implying DB uniqueness). Even if a TOCTOU race bypasses the app check, the DB rejects the second concurrent insert at L285 with a unique violation, which is handled gracefully.
